$sources: SCI P355 Design of composite and non-composite cellular beams (2011) on EN 1993-1-1 resistances; EN 1993-1-13 (beams with large web openings) not entered
source: Castellated and cellular beams by the SCI P355 method on the EN 1993-1-1 resistances (γM0, γM1 = 1.0): tees under axial force and Vierendeel bending, tee shear, web post horizontal shear, web post buckling as a strut on curve c; see VERIFY.md

clauses.teeAxial: SCI P355 Sec 3 (tee axial and bending), EN 1993-1-1 6.2.9
clauses.vierendeel: SCI P355 Sec 3 (Vierendeel bending, le = 0.45 d0)
clauses.horizontalShear: SCI P355 Sec 3 (web post horizontal shear)
clauses.webPost: SCI P355 Sec 3 (web post buckling, strut), EN 1993-1-1 6.3.1 curve c
clauses.chordBuckling: EN 1993-1-1 6.3.1 (the compression tee between lateral restraints)
